cases.shape: interface reference merge followed by a disjoint primitive local lifetime
cases.expected_intent: Reference merge and independent primitive lifetime must not become one conflicting source variable.

cases.shape: nullable reference merge and loop-carried slot lifetime
cases.expected_intent: Two branches produce distinct reference implementations; a later loop overwrites the merge slot and observes null separately.

cases.shape: generic argument flows through a holder and interface sink
cases.expected_intent: A parameterized value traverses Holder<T>, Relay<T>, and Sink<T> without raw conversion.

cases.shape: generic argument flows through a two-stage container/interface pipeline
cases.expected_intent: A value passes through a generic source, mapped container, and consumer interface using a different API shape from development.

cases.shape: prefix/postfix values consumed in call arguments and assignment expression
cases.expected_intent: Observe old and new values while a compound expression consumes an assignment result more than once.

cases.shape: postfix value used as array index and assignment result passed to a helper
cases.expected_intent: Index evaluation and returned assignment value are both observed in order; source structure differs from development.

cases.shape: effectful receiver, field update, array index and RHS ordering
cases.expected_intent: Trace receiver selection, index selection, RHS evaluation, field mutation, and array store.
exception_paths: throwing RHS at n=9 (development) or n=4 (holdout)

cases.shape: effectful method arguments feed field and array lvalues
cases.expected_intent: Argument effects precede RHS effects; array receiver/index are evaluated once before store.
exception_paths: throwing RHS at n=9 (development) or n=4 (holdout)

cases.shape: loop with per-iteration ordinary catch and continued execution
cases.expected_intent: Selected iterations throw inside a loop; catch records the event and subsequent iterations proceed.

cases.shape: outer catch around loop with inner per-item catch
cases.expected_intent: Nested ordinary catches distinguish local recovery from loop-wide failure and preserve trace order.

cases.shape: nested loops with labeled break/continue, return and throw destinations
cases.expected_intent: Different conditions exercise labeled loop exits, method return, and an exception caught outside both loops.

cases.shape: nested enhanced/index loops with distinct exit destinations
cases.expected_intent: An inner loop break, outer-loop continue, early return, and propagated throw follow separate paths.

cases.shape: generic method inference selects overloads with consistent declared type
cases.expected_intent: Bounded generic return and overloaded String/Integer calls retain source-level argument and result types.

cases.shape: generic declaration and overloaded invocation through a typed relay
cases.expected_intent: Generic type parameter is preserved through a relay and overloaded target; distinct method declarations and call sites from development.

cases.shape: anonymous instances capture locals and run instance initializers at two creation sites
cases.expected_intent: Branch-selected anonymous implementations capture a value; initializer and method effects append to trace.

cases.shape: multiple anonymous creation points in a loop with captured per-iteration values
cases.expected_intent: Anonymous objects are created at distinct expressions, each initializer captures a stable local and effects are observed in creation order.
